editorial:
Imagine a world where every drug you can think of is totally legal. That is the wild setup you get here. You follow Frank, a cop who thinks he is just doing his job, but he quickly finds out that this drug-friendly society is a total lie. The vibe is dark and gritty, making you feel like you are walking through a rainy, neon-lit city where nobody can be trusted. It feels like a classic detective story but with a futuristic twist that keeps you guessing about who is actually in charge of the city.

The acting is solid and the plot twists keep the story moving, though some parts of the middle feel a bit slow. If you love mysteries that make you think, you will really dig this one. It is a great pick for a weekend movie night.
endingExplained: You find out that the government is not just letting people use drugs for fun. They are actually using the drugs to control the population and keep everyone numb. Frank discovers a huge conspiracy involving the people at the top. In the end, the truth comes out about how the city is run, but it shows that fighting a system this big is almost impossible. Frank realizes the whole city is just a giant experiment.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves futuristic noir and conspiracy theories.
